biotools.summary: iSHARC is a Snakemake-based pipeline designed for analyzing single-cell Multiome data, facilitating quality control, integration, clustering, and regulatory mechanism analysis. The pipeline is open-source and available on GitHub with detailed documentation and installation instructions.
